description:
For Arp Frique’s new musical endeavor, he joins forces with a range of stellar vocalists: Brandon Delagraentiss, Rocq-E Harrell, Muriel Blijd and others.
For this 12” single, Another Taste lend their special touch on the rhythm section, arrangements and production.
credits:
All songs written & composed by Arp Frique.
Lyrics by Arp Frique.
Vocal arrangements by Brandon Delagraentiss and Arp Frique.
Production, additional arrangements and instrumental performance 
by Another Taste.
Drums - Teun van Zoggel
Bass - Bob Roche
Keyboards - Barend Lippens
Guitar - Florian Verhagen
Percussion - DIogo Carvalho
Engineered and mixed by Bobby van Putten.
